phrases.pattern: ^\s*>?\s*(?:\*\*[^*]+\*\*:?\s*)?\**(One caveat|One exception|One catch|One more thing|The catch|The practical consequence|The upshot|The good news|The bad news)\b
phrases.label: pseudo-callout opener
phrases.fix: delete the marker and lead with the fact, or carry it in an allowed callout label (Warning, Note, Tip, Additional Resources)

phrases.pattern: ^\s*>?\s*(?:\*\*[^*]+\*\*:?\s*)?\**(Heads up|A word of warning|A word of caution|When in doubt|Worth noting|That said|In short|Long story short|Put simply|Simply put)\b
phrases.label: conversational opener
phrases.fix: delete the marker and state the fact

phrases.label: conversational interjection
phrases.fix: delete the interjection and state the fact

phrases.label: either way
phrases.fix: name the outcomes you mean, or drop the connective

phrases.label: worth knowing
phrases.fix: state the fact without framing it as advice
